reasons.correctness: createTicket now publishes SupportTicketCreatedEvent through ApplicationEventPublisher and no longer calls EmailService. The event constructor, getters and listener signature match the interface. Harness results: build green, hidden acceptance tests 3/3, existing tests 54/54.
reasons.convention_fit: The listener sits in support/ticket/event and uses @TransactionalEventListener(AFTER_COMMIT) with @RequiredArgsConstructor. It catches and logs its own failures. Injection is through the constructor. A new *UnitTest uses MockitoExtension. The changed-constructor tests were updated and run.
reasons.design_fit: It reuses Spring's event mechanism, following the InvoiceCreatedEvent and InvoiceCreatedEventListener structure. The service publishes and the listener owns the mail side effect. Footprint is minimal. The only nit: the log keeps e.getMessage() and drops the stack trace.
reasons.test_quality: The listener test pins the forwarded arguments and the swallowed exception, but the swallow test asserts nothing explicitly. The service test verifies the published event fields and no emailService interaction. The language field is not asserted.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries listed the support/ticket package and found existing *EventListener files. The agent then read InvoiceCreatedEventListener before writing, and the edits followed it. Test discovery relied on glob, find and grep.
